summary: In the prototype presentation and evaluation meeting, the team reviewed the iPod-inspired remote control featuring a durable sliding mechanism and transparent hard plastic casing. The remote utilizes a two-tier layout with primary controls and volume scroll wheel on the exterior face, while the slide-out tray houses menu arrows, speech configuration keys, and LED backlight selectors. A locator speaker and battery power indicator were confirmed. Project finances were finalized at a production cost of 12.3 Euros against a target retail price of 20 Euros. Project Manager was assigned to compile the final project report.
decisions: Approved an iPod-inspired rounded casing manufactured from durable transparent hard plastic
Adopted a two-tier sliding mechanism instead of a flip hinge for improved mechanical durability
Organized primary controls and side scroll wheel on the top face, with advanced menu and speech keys on the slide-out tray
Integrated semi-transparent backlit keypad buttons with slide-activated tray illumination
Retained a locator speaker beneath the logo and an integrated battery power level indicator
Finalized financial baseline at 12.3 Euros production cost and 20.0 Euros target retail price

action_items.task: Compile the final project report consolidating prototype specifications, evaluation scores, and financial metrics
